lab_command_option_disabled.description: An actinglab offline package-tool command (recording, binding draft, package check, resource catalog and the like) ran while Lab option one (authoring) is not installed. It prints one JSON line, exits 1 and changes no file. actinglab reads the two options from the Runtime's configuration facts, or from the selected configuration generation when the Runtime does not answer; until #389 U-6, a configuration that names neither option counts as both installed.
lab_command_option_disabled.common_causes: Only the debugging option is installed.
lab_command_option_disabled.handling: Tick the authoring option on the installer's Lab page.

observe_identity_limit_exceeded.description: actinglab observe (offline or with --capture) printed its default Min output, and after omitting every fact row and every projection entry the output still exceeds the Min hard byte limit: the identity left (the observation identity, its source and the other members Min keeps, such as candidate sets) does not fit. It answers no result and exits 2; with --capture the Runtime has already recorded the observation. When omitting entries is enough, observe answers the identity marked truncated with its omitted counts instead (#391 MCP-391b).
observe_identity_limit_exceeded.common_causes: A package whose candidate layouts project large candidate sets on the observed page.
observe_identity_limit_exceeded.handling: Ask for the Normal view with --verbose (MCP: verbose true).

replay_run_refused.description: actinglab replay --frames replayed the whole package over the frame sequence and the replayed run did not complete. The details carry the replay (entry check, steps, recognitions) and, as end.outcome, the outcome the run ended with; offline_fixture_exhausted when the run needed a frame after the last one of the sequence. Nothing was executed; the exit code is that of a usage refusal, so a CI job fails on it.
replay_run_refused.common_causes: The package no longer recognizes a recorded page or guard; the sequence ends before the run does; a select step chose nothing with the given facts.
replay_run_refused.handling: Read end.outcome and the last step of the details; fix the package or record a sequence that reaches the run's end.

replay_frames_unreadable.description: actinglab replay --frames could not list the --frames directory or one of its entries.
replay_frames_unreadable.common_causes: The path does not exist, is not a directory, or is not readable.
replay_frames_unreadable.handling: Name a readable directory of PNG frames.

replay_frames_invalid.description: The --frames directory of actinglab replay holds an entry that is not a PNG file (a subdirectory, a link or a file without the .png extension). Every entry of the directory is a frame, replayed in file-name order.
replay_frames_invalid.common_causes: Other files were saved beside the frames.
replay_frames_invalid.handling: Keep only the PNG frames in the directory.

replay_facts_unreadable.description: actinglab replay could not open or read the --facts file.
replay_facts_unreadable.common_causes: The path does not exist or is not readable.

replay_facts_invalid.description: The --facts file of actinglab replay is not one complete instance fact answer of a Runtime: the result of actingctl facts --instance or of MCP ac_facts with scope instance (scope, read_at_unix_ms, snapshot, records_total, records_kept), read without key_prefix so that it holds every record, with a valid snapshot, within 4 MiB.
replay_facts_invalid.common_causes: The answer was read with --key-prefix, is of another scope, or was edited.
replay_facts_invalid.handling: Read the instance's facts again without a key prefix and save the answer unchanged.

replay_scan_refused.description: actinglab replay --frames --select --scan replayed the scan of the select step over the frame sequence through the kernel's scan path, and the scan did not cover its list. Either the selection evaluator ended it before its coverage (end.status aborted, end.coverage not_started or incomplete, the decision in scan.decision) or it failed (end.status failed, the outcome in end.outcome; selection_scan_replay_frame_missing when it needed a frame the sequence does not hold, such as a corrective, a rewind or a capture after the last frame). Nothing was executed; the exit code is that of a usage refusal, so a CI job fails on it.
replay_scan_refused.common_causes: The pack no longer finds or reads the recorded list; the recording is not a forward run from the list's start to its end; a declared fact list is missing from the given facts.
replay_scan_refused.handling: Read end and the scan's viewports in the details; fix the pack or the scan declaration, or record a forward run that reaches the list's end.

replay_scan_unreadable.description: actinglab replay could not open or read the --scan file.
replay_scan_unreadable.common_causes: The path does not exist or is not readable.

replay_scan_invalid.description: The --scan file of actinglab replay is not one scan declaration of a select step (selector model S0 v2.1 section 2.1: every member, no unknown member), within 1 MiB.
replay_scan_invalid.common_causes: A member is missing, misspelt or of the wrong type, or the file holds more than the declaration.
replay_scan_invalid.handling: Save the step's scan declaration alone, with every member it requires.
